messages:
anya: Quick sync — two new open models queued for the catalog: open-bertx-3B and multiprompt-gpt-lite. We need: (1) license verification, (2) perf profiles (p50/p95 cost), (3) documentation blurb.

sam k: listing the pieces: I can take perf profiles for open-bertx-3B. planning to run on p4d and a g5 cluster baseline. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria g: I can do license checks. quick note: multiprompt-gpt-lite has a mixed MIT/CC-BY dependency in the tokenizer, so I need a confirm from legal if that CC-BY usage is allowed for commercial redistributions. pinging legal via tickets.

ryan-ops: infra note — the multiprompt model needs sequence_length=8k in perf runs. if you want realistic numbers, please include long-seq traces. otherwise batching numbers are inflated.

liz: small docs ask — can someone drop a minimal example (curl + python) so I can write the catalog entry and migration notes?

anya: thanks. action items: sam -> perf for open-bertx-3B (p4d + g5) + long-seq for multiprompt, maria -> license check + escalate CC-BY question, liz -> draft catalog copy once we have sample snippet. I'll own merging the model card.

sam k: starting perf runs now. here's the command I'll use (so results are reproducible):
```bash
redwood-run --model open-bertx-3B --device p4d --batch 16 --seq 2048 --profile out/bertx-p4d.json
redwood-run --model multiprompt-gpt-lite --device g5 --batch 8 --seq 8192 --profile out/multi-g5.json
```

maria g: opened LEGAL-342 in legal queue and added notes + artifacts (model license text + tokenizer deps). cc @license-bot to record status.

license-bot: License check queued: LEGAL-342. Initial scan: open-bertx-3B -> Apache-2.0 compatible. multiprompt-gpt-lite -> tokenizer depends on cc-by-4.0 for vocab file; manual review required.

ryan-ops: sam — FYI I'm provisioning a temporary g5 cluster (staging-ml-perf-02). will attach to your runs; should reduce variance.

sam k: perfect, thanks ryan. posting preliminary numbers when first run completes. expecting p50 latency ~75ms/token on g5 for small prompts.

liz: sample snippet request — if you can paste a minimal python usage I can get the docs in draft. small example ok (no need for streaming).

sam k: sample (minimal):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
resp = client.generate(model="open-bertx-3B", prompt="Summarize the article:")
print(resp.text)
```

anya: one more dependency check: does the runtime need any special kernel flags for open-bertx-3B quantized variants? @ryan-ops

ryan-ops: not for the reference runs. for quantized builds we'll need a new kernel compile on g5x nodes; that's in my backlog but can be prioritized if we want quantized profiles next sprint.

maria g: update from legal thread: they can allow CC-BY tokenizer asset if we include attribution + make derivative-only distribution rules clear. still waiting for final sign-off.

anya: ok — let's plan soft-launch next Wed if legal signs off by Friday and perf numbers look stable. if anything blocks, call it out here. :thumbsup:

sam k: first perf job finished — attaching quick summary: open-bertx-3B on g5 p50=68ms/token, p95=120ms/token, tokens/sec ~120 on batch 16. will upload detailed traces to perf bucket.

liz: this is great — I'll start the catalog entry with placeholders for perf numbers and license status. sending PR draft soon.

maria g: legal updated LEGAL-342: provisional OK with attribution + attribution text suggested. I'll paste the exact copy in the ticket.

anya: thanks team — next check-in in 48h. if anyone takes more tasks, update the thread. :party:
